ActivityEvidence.description:
The latest recorded result for one verification activity.

Unknown fields are ignored so that files written by a later rqtk still load.

commit.description: Commit checked out when the evidence was recorded.

requirement.description: Requirement that owned the activity when the evidence was recorded.

requirement_hash.description:
The requirement's content hash when the evidence was recorded. If the requirement's
current hash differs, the evidence is stale and the activity is Suspect.

tests.description:
Test cases that produced the outcome, as `path::name`: the linked test's source file
and the name the runner gave the case.

tests_hash.description: Hash of the linked tests' source when they last ran.

unchanged_tests.description:
The requirement was re-verified after it changed, by the same tests that passed for
its earlier wording. It stays Suspect until someone runs `rqtk review`.

upstream.description:
Content hashes of the requirement's ancestors and of the needs they satisfy, when this
version of the requirement was first verified. A later change to any of them makes
the requirement Suspect until it is reviewed.

ActivityRun.description: What a test run says about one activity.

ambiguous.description:
Linked tests whose name matches several distinct tests in the results, so the
run can't say which one is linked.

missing.description:
Linked test functions with no passing or failing result in the run
(absent, or skipped).

tests.description: IDs of the matched test cases, sorted.

Ambiguity.description: A linked test that matched several distinct tests in the results.

EvidenceChange.description: How one activity's entry changed when new results were applied.

SourceLink.description: A `verifies` annotation found in source code.

activity.description: Verification activity ID named by the annotation.

aliases.description:
Other names runners report the test under: JUnit `@DisplayName` and
`@ParameterizedTest(name = …)` (Gradle uses them), xUnit `DisplayName`.

case.description: One case of a table-driven or parameterised test.

group.description: The annotation names a group of tests (`describe`, `context`) rather than one test.

path.description: Path relative to the repository root.

source_hash.description:
Hash of the test's source (its attributes, declaration and body), used to tell
whether a test changed between runs.

suite.description:
Suite the test runner reports with the name, such as `Suite` in GoogleTest's
`TEST(Suite, Name)`.

test_name.description:
Name of the annotated test, or of the test group for a `describe` block. `None` when
no test declaration follows the annotation.

commit.description: Commit the evidence was recorded at; `None` before the first commit or outside git.

not_in_results.description:
Linked tests with no result in these files: normal for a partial run, otherwise a
sign the runner names them differently.

unattached_links.description:
`verifies` annotations with no test declaration below them (RQ030); no result can
ever match them.
